subject: Trunk battery area: what sits where, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Open the trunk battery area".

mustShow.text: HERO: A single 12 V battery on the right side of the luggage compartment, under the trunk cover/panel.
A distribution box attached to the top of the battery (BMW calls it the rear power distribution box; its fuse links cannot be replaced individually).
The negative battery post with its clamp; the intelligent battery sensor is part of the negative lead. Do not disturb the sensor.
